==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue start}}
:'''Uncle Wei:''' I repair and make Tacetite Weapons here. Everyone likes to call me Uncle Wei.
:{{DIcon|Weapon Shop}} I want to rearm.
:{{DIcon}} Gourmet Rumors
::'''Uncle Wei:''' Interested in weapon crafting, are you?
::{{DIcon}} Oh, no. That's not why we're here today.
::'''Uncle Wei:''' Oh? Besides my skills, what else could you possibly want from an old-timer like me?
::{{DIcon}} Do you know how to make the marinade?
::'''Uncle Wei:''' ...
::'''Uncle Wei:''' I'm a Crafting expert, and you're asking me about cooktops? What's going on in that young head of yours?
::{{DIcon}} ...Apologies for the inconvenience.
::'''Uncle Wei:''' Wait, hold on, I never said I didn't know.
::'''Uncle Wei:''' I'm not sure about the specifics, but my wife always puts Fowl in the pot before she makes the marinade.
::'''Uncle Wei:''' She says it makes everything taste meaty, and our son loves it... hmm.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
----
:'''Uncle Wei:''' That weapon on you seems well maintained. You must be a Resonator.
:{{DIcon}} Indeed, I am.
:'''Uncle Wei:''' Yeah, I can tell. You're holding a Tacetite Weapon, after all.
:'''Uncle Wei:''' You've probably used it countless times by now, but I'm sure you're not familiar with how it's made.
:'''Uncle Wei:''' The more you understand, the handier it will be. If you're curious about Tacetite weapons, feel free to ask me anything. 
:{{DIcon}} What are Tacetite Weapons?
::'''Uncle Wei:''' Tacetite Weapons are designed for Resonators to combat Tacet Discords.
::'''Uncle Wei:''' These weapons are adaptable in form and size for different needs. They're all essentially the same thing.
:{{DIcon|Arrow}} Tell me about different types of Tacetite Weapons. 
::'''Uncle Wei:''' There are five main types of Tacetite Weapons. Pistols, Gauntlets, Rectifiers, Swords, and Broadblades. 
::'''Uncle Wei:''' Which one piques your interest?
::{{DIcon}} [[Pistols]].
:::'''Uncle Wei:''' Pistols are compact firearms that use Resonance Energy to create powerful bullet projectiles.
:::'''Uncle Wei:''' The amount of energy used determines the bullets' effects. You'll understand once you try it yourself.
:::'''Uncle Wei:''' Compared to traditional guns, these Tacetite pistols have low recoil and do not require frequent reloading. Perfect for ranged combat.
::{{DIcon}} [[Gauntlets]].
:::'''Uncle Wei:''' Gauntlets are arm-mounted combat gear, commonly worn as gloves or vambraces.
:::'''Uncle Wei:''' With a limited range, their design priortizes both offense and defense capabilities.
:::'''Uncle Wei:''' This makes them highly selective in terms of material and the physical abilities of their wielders.
::{{DIcon}} [[Rectifier]]s.
:::'''Uncle Wei:''' Rectifiers capture and amplify specific frequencies. I'd say they work more like musical instruments.
:::'''Uncle Wei:''' While not as lethal, they have the strongest amplification effect on Resonance Abilities, or Fortes as we call it.
:::'''Uncle Wei:''' Additionally, Rectifiers can scan and interfere with the unique frequencies of Tacet Discords. As a type of Tacetite Weapon, Rectifiers test the user's skills.
::{{DIcon}} [[Sword]]s.
:::'''Uncle Wei:''' Swords are a stable weapon for Resonators like you, with their balanced and agile design.
:::'''Uncle Wei:''' They're versatile and efficient in combat, making them a popular choice for dealing with different enemies.
:::'''Uncle Wei:''' That being said. Swords are also the hardest to master among of all Tacetite Weapons. They may seem simple, but there's more to them than meets the eye.
::{{DIcon}} [[Broadblade]]s.
:::'''Uncle Wei:''' Need a weapon to take down tough Tacet Discords? Then the Broadblade is your choice. It does a lot of damage.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} 
{{Dialogue end}}
